entries.en: The theater added two comedies to its repertory this season.

entries.zh: 肖像捕捉了音乐家若有所思的面容。

entries.en: The inquiry found evidence of wilful neglect of the building.
entries.zh: 调查发现了故意疏于维护这栋建筑的证据。

entries.en: A red buoy marked the entrance to the narrow channel.
entries.zh: 一枚红色浮标标出了狭窄航道的入口。

entries.en: Her fervent support kept the restoration campaign alive.
entries.zh: 她热切的支持使修复运动得以持续。

entries.en: He held no grudge against the rival who defeated him.
entries.zh: 他对打败自己的对手并不怀恨。

entries.en: The queue at the checkout reached the bakery counter.
entries.zh: 收银台的队伍一直排到了面包柜台。

entries.en: The threatened closure galvanized residents into organizing a public meeting.
entries.zh: 可能关闭的消息促使居民组织了一场公众会议。

entries.en: The first test was inconclusive, so researchers repeated the measurements.
entries.zh: 第一次测试没有定论，因此研究人员重复了测量。

entries.en: What seemed an innocuous question started a lively debate.
entries.zh: 一个看似无伤大雅的问题引发了热烈讨论。

entries.en: The novel follows an outcast seeking acceptance in a small town.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一个被排斥的人在小镇寻求接纳的经历。

entries.en: An ineffectual fan did little to cool the crowded room.
entries.zh: 一台效果很差的风扇几乎没让拥挤的房间凉快下来。

entries.en: The narrator repeatedly praises the hero's manly confidence.
entries.zh: 叙述者反复赞扬主人公富有男子气概的自信。

entries.en: The narrow path allowed only two walkers abreast.
entries.zh: 这条窄路只容得下两人并肩行走。

entries.en: Her meek reply surprised those who expected an argument.
entries.zh: 她温顺的回答让那些以为会发生争执的人感到意外。

entries.en: A minor mishap with the costumes delayed the opening scene.
entries.zh: 服装方面的一个小意外耽误了开场。

entries.en: The archive preserves these voices for posterity.
entries.zh: 档案馆为后世保存了这些声音。

entries.en: Years of planning came to fruition when the library opened.
entries.zh: 图书馆开放时，多年的规划终于实现。

entries.en: The hot iron scorched a small patch of fabric.
entries.zh: 热熨斗烫焦了一小块布料。

entries.en: The lecturer expounded her theory with examples from local history.
entries.zh: 讲师用地方史中的例子详细阐述了自己的理论。

entries.en: Damp conditions had warped the old cupboard doors.
entries.zh: 潮湿环境使旧橱柜门翘曲了。

entries.en: The buzzer sounded when the contestant pressed the red button.
entries.zh: 参赛者按下红色按钮时，蜂鸣器响了。

entries.en: The gardener inspected the graft on the young apple tree.
entries.zh: 园丁检查了小苹果树的嫁接处。

entries.en: A tinge of pink spread across the eastern sky.
entries.zh: 一抹淡粉色在东方天空铺展开来。

entries.en: I was envious of her room overlooking the harbor.
entries.zh: 我很羡慕她那间可以俯瞰港口的房间。

entries.en: Soft lamps gave the restaurant a calm, intimate ambience.
entries.zh: 柔和的灯光给餐厅营造了安静亲密的氛围。

entries.meaningZh: 议事阻挠（以冗长发言拖延）
entries.en: The documentary explains how a filibuster delayed the final vote.
entries.zh: 纪录片解释了以冗长发言拖延议事、推迟最终投票的过程。

entries.en: We collated the survey responses before preparing the report.
entries.zh: 我们先整理汇集调查回答，再准备报告。

entries.en: A sumptuous banquet followed the opening of the new theater.
entries.zh: 新剧院开幕后，举行了一场豪华丰盛的宴会。

entries.en: The heroine spurns the offer of a comfortable but dishonest life.
entries.zh: 女主人公拒绝了过舒适却不诚实生活的提议。

entries.en: His hoarse voice was barely audible over the crowd.
entries.zh: 在人群喧闹声中，他沙哑的声音几乎听不见。

entries.en: Her explanation sounded unconvincing without the missing documents.
entries.zh: 缺了那些文件，她的解释听起来缺乏说服力。

entries.en: A belated apology arrived long after the argument had ended.
entries.zh: 争论结束很久以后，一声迟来的道歉才到来。

entries.en: His antipathy toward public speaking made the invitation unwelcome.
entries.zh: 他对公开演讲的反感让这份邀请不受欢迎。

entries.en: A sparrow carried dry grass into a gap beneath the roof.
entries.zh: 一只麻雀把干草叼进了屋顶下的缝隙。

entries.en: The vagaries of mountain weather disrupted our carefully planned route.
entries.zh: 山区天气变幻莫测，打乱了我们精心安排的路线。

entries.en: Judicious use of mirrors made the tiny room appear larger.
entries.zh: 巧妙审慎地使用镜子，让小房间显得更大。

entries.en: The diligent assistant checked every label before the exhibition opened.
entries.zh: 勤勉的助理在展览开幕前检查了每个标签。

entries.en: The stone edifice dominates the square beside the harbor.
entries.zh: 这座石砌宏伟建筑耸立在港口旁的广场上。

entries.en: Whether the new entrance improved access remains debatable.
entries.zh: 新入口是否改善了通行，仍有争议。

entries.en: She was coy about the ending of her new novel.
entries.zh: 谈到新小说的结局时，她故作神秘。

entries.en: The faded sign led us astray near the old quarry.
entries.zh: 褪色的标牌在旧采石场附近把我们引错了路。

entries.en: The clear safety briefing helped allay the visitors' fears.
entries.zh: 清楚的安全说明帮助减轻了游客们的担忧。
